reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a wider variety of session types – long runs, hill work, tempo runs – which directly addresses different aspects of trail running performance. Plan A’s inclusion of a tempo run is particularly beneficial for increasing speed, while Plan B’s focus is almost entirely on aerobic endurance, neglecting the crucial element of speed development. Furthermore, Plan A’s longer runs (26km) are more aligned with the demands of trail races, building a greater capacity for sustained effort.
